definitions.gloss: shelved; buried; never released; put away permanently
definitions.explanation: Describes a project, work, plan, or product that was completed or nearly completed but never made public or was permanently set aside.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{蔵入|くらい}りになった。
⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧お{蔵入|くらい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧。
examples.english: I hope the project doesn't get shelved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{終|お}わっていた→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}して→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧お{蔵入|くらい}りになった。
examples.english: Filming was finished, but problems came to light and it was shelved.

notes:
Literally "put into the storehouse." The ⟦{蔵|くら}→蔵：13991_kura⟧ was a traditional storehouse where things were kept out of sight. The お prefix adds a slightly formal or set-phrase quality. Commonly used in the entertainment industry for unreleased works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{蔵入|くらい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be shelved
- お{蔵入|くらい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to shelve (something)
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧お{蔵入|くらい}りだった: had been shelved for years
- お{蔵入|くらい}り⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: a shelved work

USAGE:
Frequently used for movies, TV episodes, albums, or projects that were completed but never released, typically due to scandals, legal issues, quality concerns, or changes in circumstances. Also used more broadly for any plan or idea that gets permanently set aside.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ボツ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be rejected, scrapped — implies the idea was actively rejected before completion
- お{蔵入|くらい}り implies something completed but withheld from release
